name: 木遁·扦插之术
description: 对4格内1个敌人造成等同攻击力的伤害，并沉默1回合。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 4, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; dealDamage(caster, target, Math.floor(caster.attack * 1.0), 'physical', battle, 'hashirama-edo-wood-spike'); if (target.currentHp <= 0) return { success: true, message: caster.name + '使用木遁·扦插之术，' + target.name + '被击败' }; if (!target.statusTags) target.statusTags = []; var already = target.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'silenced'; }); if (!already) { target.statusTags.push({ id: 'silenced-' + target.instanceId, type: 'silenced', name: '沉默', visible: true, remainingDuration: 1, remainingUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, relatedRules: ['rule-silenced-block'] }); addRuleById(target.instanceId, 'rule-silenced-block'); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '使用木遁·扦插之术，使' + target.name + '沉默1回合' }; }
